en.summary: Dune: Awakening's console edition brings Funcom's open-world survival MMO to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on September 22, 2026, more than a year after its June 2025 PC debut, arriving day one on Xbox Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass with full Xbox Play Anywhere cross-progression. The console release bundles every content update and improvement shipped on PC to date, alongside a major simultaneous update completing the finale of the game's Book One story across all platforms.

guideSections.title: Built for Controllers
guideSections.description: Rather than a straight port, Funcom rebuilt Dune: Awakening's controls and UI specifically for console play, offering a Performance mode targeting 60fps on PS5 and Xbox Series X and a Quality mode that prioritizes visuals, alongside a physical PlayStation 5 edition.

guideSections.title: A New Single-Player Mode
guideSections.description: The September 2026 update adds a full single-player mode with scalable difficulty on top of the existing multiplayer survival experience, letting players experience the complete Book One cinematic story — spanning Acts 1 through 4 — solo from start to finish for the first time.
